Reference / db/postgres/wire

db/postgres/wire#

PostgreSQL frontend/backend protocol 3.0 framing, written in Okkama.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

PostgreSQL frontend/backend protocol 3.0 framing, written in Okkama.

Frontend messages are a type byte, a big-endian Int32 length that counts itself, and a body (the startup family omits the type byte). PgInput reads whole backend messages from a borrowed AsyncReading through one buffer and an offset, so each message costs its own size; a message longer than 1 GiB or a closed stream is PgWireFailure. Nothing here interprets message semantics: db/postgres owns the conversation. Integers and strings are read in place (encoding/bytes); DataRow messages can be taken raw, many at once, for a result page.
